packages/compiler/src/environment-policy.rationale: Keeps environment-derived compiler defaults isolated from request processing.

packages/compiler/src/module-metadata.ts.rationale: Owns deterministic SCC metadata convergence, cache identity, and fail-closed graph state.

packages/compiler/src/native-loader.ts.rationale: Owns platform resolution and the typed boundary for all native compiler entrypoints.

packages/compiler/src/native-target.ts.rationale: Keeps supported host and package target selection explicit and deterministic.

packages/compiler/src/types.ts.rationale: Owns the documented request limits, structured ICE shape, options, and result contracts.
